title: Texans WR Collins gets raise in reworked contract

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Texans WR Collins gets raise in reworked contract
sources.description: Two-time Pro Bowl wide receiver Nico Collins and the Texans reached agreement on an adjusted contract that guarantees his salary the next two seasons and includes a $9 million cash increase this year and an $8 million cash increase next year.
